_note: MarketPlaza, the in-game shop app (D-114). Your listings sell from shop search even with no video; a video sends buyers to a listing. Price is the listing price as a share of the product's usual price; a lower price sells more often (priceElastic). search.perHour is orders per game hour for one listing at heat 0.5, trust 50, usual price, no reviews. Courier (D-113): one pickup window a day. Book before the cutoff for today's window, otherwise it is tomorrow's. The courier comes at some time inside the window and waits waitMin minutes at the door; you hand over packed parcels there. Orders not handed over by shipByMin after they came are cancelled. Times are minutes after midnight.
